pr_title: modem: ppp: gsm: extract access technology
pr_body:
Some modems supports multiple access technologies. The access technology of the serving cell can be extracted from the +CEREG command, which is already sent to the modem.

The parse function is extended to also parse the access technology value.

Fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/51153.

Signed-off-by: Jeppe Odgaard <jeppe.odgaard@prevas.dk>

issue_context.title: modem: ppp: extract access technology when MODEM_CELL_INFO is enabled

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
None.

None.
